title:
Assessing sensitivity to semantic and syntactic information in deaf readers: An ERP
study
description: This dataset contains EEG/ERP data from an experiment examining sensitivity to semantic and syntactic violations in deaf readers. Participants read sentences presented word-by-word (RSVP) that contained subject-verb agreement violations, semantic violations, combined violations, word-order violations, or correct control sentences, while EEG was recorded. The study aims to characterize how deaf readers process linguistic anomalies at the neural level.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room viewing an LCD monitor at 60 inches distance, using a keyboard for responses and a headset for verbal responses. They were presented with 180 sentences (30 subject-verb agreement violations, 30 semantic violations, 30 double violations, 30 word-order violations, 60 control sentences) in an RSVP design, one word at a time, each displayed for 600ms with a 200ms inter-stimulus interval, while EEG was recorded.
